shorts.title: The Smallest Dinosaur Ever Found Turned Out to Be a Lizard
shorts.outro: The next thing in that amber really is a bird, with teeth. Doug went looking for its nest. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT LANDED BEHIND DOUG AT THE NEST?
shorts.description: In 2020 a thumbnail-sized skull in amber was hailed as the smallest dinosaur ever found, until a second specimen showed Oculudentavis was a lizard, and the full episode reveals what Doug met when he went looking for a real toothed bird's nest.

shorts.title: This 99-Million-Year-Old Hell Ant Died Mid-Kill in Amber
shorts.outro: This hell ant's final victim was a young cockroach relative. So Doug dressed as one and said hi. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: DID THE HELL ANT FALL FOR IT?
shorts.description: A hell ant in 99-million-year-old amber was caught pinning a young cockroach relative between its upward-snapping jaws and the horn on its head, and the full episode reveals whether it fell for Doug in a cockroach costume.

shorts.title: A Feathered Dinosaur Tail Was Sealed in Amber With Its Skin
shorts.outro: Doug finally went back to meet the owner of this tail. It was a young one. What came with it is linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT CAME WITH THE YOUNG ONE?
shorts.description: Eva, the first dinosaur tail ever found in amber, still holds its bones, skin and 3D feathers from a sparrow-sized young dinosaur, and the full episode reveals what came with it when Doug went back to meet the owner.
